title: An error response
description: Every non-2xx response. The app reads `code`; `message` is never shown to people.

errors.description: A 422 only: each field's translated messages.

retryAfter.description: A 429 only: seconds to wait, as the Retry-After header.

current.description: A 409 version_conflict only: the server's copy, to keep or to save over (with its version).

reason.description: A 403 project_read_only only: why it's read-only (limit: beyond a plan's project limit, where an install sets one).

usedBytes.description: A 403 storage_limit only: the bytes the account's takes use now, as usage.show's storage.usedBytes.

limitBytes.description: A 403 storage_limit only: the plan's allowance, as usage.show's storage.limitBytes.

sentToday.description: A 409 daily_limit only (admin.mudeo.send and .batches.create): how many were sent today.

limit.description: A 409 daily_limit only (admin.mudeo.send and .batches.create): today's cap.

bar.description: A 422 below_bar only: the bar the take didn't clear.

billing.description: A 409 store_linked_elsewhere only: billing.show's data, so the app shows where it stands.

email.description: A 409 confirm_sign_in only: the account a link would sign into, to ask "Sign in as ...?".

freeFrom.description: A 451 not_available_here only: the year the song is free where the visitor is (from 1 January), or null when that can't be known yet.
